body:
Refreshed Semi-Vanilla 26.1.2 SMP

Luminara (formerly known as Nether Depths) is a semi-vanilla survival multiplayer server with no grief, no theft, and quality of life features.

Friendly Community Our community is friendly, helpful, and fun! There are so many memories to create in this server.

Quick Updates We're always one of the first to update our Minecraft version and we're planning to update to 27.1 once it is released as soon as possible!

Bedrock-Compatible On the go? No problem! You can join on Minecraft Bedrock Edition! IP: br.luminaramc.org PORT: 53778

Find out more about the many features of Luminara at https://luminaramc.org !
